topic.title: 15 Things in Every 1960s Kitchen That Have Vanished Forever
topic.angle: A slow walk through Mom's mustard, avocado and harvest-gold kitchen: the wall phone with the long cord, the percolator, the bread box, the Jell-O mold. Each item is something viewers can picture and want to tell a story about.
topic.why: Home & Kitchen serisi (1/4). Homes & Gardens'ın 9 Ekim haberi ('60s mutfak renkleri geri dönüyor) taze bir kanca veriyor. Ortak ABD-Kanada hafızasına dayanıyor ve çok görsel. Kapak: hardal sarısı mutfakta duvar telefonu.
